scope: Synthetic platform checks and registry audits; no installed device, live provider, deployment or security certification.
cloud_sdk_groups: real SDK Google OAuth state, PKCE, signed ID token and persistent session (mocked Google transport)
verified provider subject preserves ownership across email changes and rejects implicit linking
unqualified native callbacks and unsupported direct-token sign-in stay closed
signed OAuth tokens with wrong signature, algorithm, issuer, audience or lifetime cannot create a session
owner-isolated session metadata and fresh revocation never expose other tokens
unauthenticated, forged cookies, foreign origins and unsupported auth paths fail closed
consent, owner isolation, upload acknowledgement and idempotent replay
simultaneous writes preserve exactly one head and remove the losing object
malformed/oversized envelopes and unsupported fields preserve current head
optional coaching consent, durable deduplication and strictly selected facts
invented model advice is refused and never returned
revoking consent cancels an in-flight provider request and prevents late publication
daily budget reservation blocks a fourth provider dispatch without a fallback
account deletion requires fresh verification before tombstoning or removing data
exhausted provider budgets cannot create unbounded jobs and accepted retries remain available
fresh-session deletion revokes auth, removes cloud objects and blocks late writes
HTTPS SDK cookies use host-only Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite attributes and preserve session revocation
qualified native schemes match the deployment brand and reject cross-brand return addresses
